data.reasoning: The deepseek model successfully audited all files, including the PKGBUILD and LICENSE.html which the qwen model failed to process due to API errors. data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement stems from an HTTP 400 API error in the qwen model, which caused it to fail on the PKGBUILD and LICENSE.html files, leading to an inconclusive result. The deepseek model successfully processed these files and correctly identified them as safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review PKGBUILD and LICENSE.html due to HTTP 400 API errors
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for LLM API calls to prevent transient HTTP errors from causing incomplete audits and inconclusive verdicts.
